PIP5KI isoforms are differentially regulated in cells and that the level of PIP2 is determined by the level of P IP5KIβ.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of phosphatidyinositol 5-phosphate (PtdInsP5) in the regulation of endocytic trafficking in mammalian cells.
the molecular mechanisms underlying constitutive endocytic trafficking.
the role of PIP5K isoforms in regulating the levels of PIP2 in cells and in regulating the rate of constitutive endo-cytosis.

PIP5KI isoforms are not redundant in the control of constitutive endocyosis.
